How does this model help you picture the size of $S_{64}$?

::: notes

Allow about 3 minutes for the video and a brief response. This follows the calculation of S_64 so students can connect the model with the total reward. Tap Play when ready; playback does not start automatically. Ask what the visual model adds to their understanding of the number. Keep the distinction between grains on one square, a_n, and the accumulated total, S_n, clear.

Internet access is required. The direct YouTube link opens the same video if the embedded player is unavailable. Leaving this slide unloads the player. If playback is unavailable, refer back to the exact sum and counting-time comparison on the preceding slide, then continue to Example 6.1.
